parameters.query:
with p as (select $1::jsonb as j),
src as (
  select nullif(r->>'ws','')   as ws,
         nullif(r->>'key','')  as api_key,
         nullif(r->>'name','') as sheet_name
  from p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j) r
),
bison as (select id from public.sequencers where key = 'emailbison'),
-- 1. existing rows: keep the key fresh, matched on the workspace id (never on a name)
upd as (
  update public.client_sequencers cs
     set api_key = src.api_key, enabled = true, updated_at = now()
    from src, bison
   where cs.external_workspace_id = src.ws
     and cs.sequencer_id = bison.id
     and cs.api_key is distinct from src.api_key
  returning cs.id
),
-- 2. workspaces with no row yet: only when the client name matches EXACTLY (case-insensitive)
new_rows as (
  select c.id as client_id, src.ws, src.api_key
  from src
  join public.clients c on lower(btrim(c.name)) = lower(btrim(src.sheet_name))
  join bison on true
  where not exists (
    select 1 from public.client_sequencers cs
    where cs.external_workspace_id = src.ws and cs.sequencer_id = bison.id
  )
),
ins as (
  insert into public.client_sequencers (client_id, sequencer_id, api_key, external_workspace_id, enabled)
  select n.client_id, (select id from bison), n.api_key, n.ws, true
  from new_rows n
  on conflict (client_id, sequencer_id) do update
    set api_key = excluded.api_key,
        external_workspace_id = coalesce(excluded.external_workspace_id, public.client_sequencers.external_workspace_id),
        enabled = true, updated_at = now()
  returning id
)
select (select count(*) from src)                                  as sheet_clients,
       (select count(*) from upd)                                  as keys_refreshed,
       (select count(*) from ins)                                  as rows_created,
       (select string_agg(src.ws || ':' || src.sheet_name, ', ' order by src.ws)
          from src
         where not exists (select 1 from public.client_sequencers cs
                            where cs.external_workspace_id = src.ws
                              and cs.sequencer_id = (select id from bison))
           and not exists (select 1 from public.clients c
                            where lower(btrim(c.name)) = lower(btrim(src.sheet_name)))) as unmatched;
